_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment — never edit shillinq_register.json
_meta.description: Two additions. (1) An additive overlay on FrameworkAgreement: `agreedPrices`, the price per product agreed with the supplier. PurchaseOrderService applies them server-side to the lines of a call-off before the order total is counted against the ceiling (REQ-PG-005). (2) ReorderProposal: the low-stock alert ReorderProposalJob raises when the stock of a reorder rule is at or below its reorder point, linked to the draft PurchaseOrder it proposes. One open proposal per rule at a time; the job resolves it once the stock is back above the point (REQ-IRA-011). Money fields are integer euro cents.

agreedPrices.description: The prices agreed with the supplier, one per product. A purchase order line for a product listed here takes the agreed unit price, whatever price the buyer typed (REQ-PG-005).

productCode.description: Product code as the purchase order line carries it.
productCode.title: Product Code

description.description: What the product is, for the buyer.
description.title: Description

unitAmount.description: Agreed price per unit, in integer euro cents.
unitAmount.title: Agreed Unit Amount (cents)

agreedPrices.title: Agreed Prices

ReorderProposal.title: Reorder Proposal
ReorderProposal.description: Low-stock alert raised by ReorderProposalJob for an active InventoryReorderRule whose stock is at or below its reorder point, with the draft PurchaseOrder it proposes for the reorder quantity with the rule's preferred supplier. At most one open proposal per rule; the job resolves it once the stock is back above the reorder point.

reorderRuleId.description: FK to the InventoryReorderRule that raised the proposal.
reorderRuleId.title: Reorder Rule

inventoryStockId.description: FK to the InventoryStock record (item and location) that ran low.
inventoryStockId.title: Inventory Stock

productId.description: Product of the stock record, copied for the list.
productId.title: Product

locationCode.description: Location of the stock record, copied for the list.
locationCode.title: Location

quantityOnHand.description: Stock on hand when the proposal was raised.
quantityOnHand.title: Quantity On Hand

reorderPoint.description: The rule's reorder point when the proposal was raised.
reorderPoint.title: Reorder Point

reorderQuantity.description: Quantity proposed, the rule's reorder quantity.
reorderQuantity.title: Reorder Quantity

supplierId.description: The rule's preferred supplier. Without one no draft purchase order is proposed; the alert stands alone.
supplierId.title: Supplier

purchaseOrderId.description: FK to the draft PurchaseOrder proposed for the buyer.
purchaseOrderId.title: Purchase Order

raisedAt.description: When the job raised the proposal.
raisedAt.title: Raised At

resolvedAt.description: When the job saw the stock back above the reorder point.
resolvedAt.title: Resolved At

open.label: Open
open.description: Stock is at or below the reorder point; the draft purchase order waits for the buyer.

resolved.label: Resolved
resolved.description: Stock is back above the reorder point (terminal).

dismissed.label: Dismissed
dismissed.description: The buyer set the proposal aside (terminal).

resolve.label: Resolve
resolve.description: Stock is back above the reorder point.

dismiss.label: Dismiss
dismiss.description: Set the proposal aside without ordering.
